Field.name: IdentificationNumber
Field.description: The primary identification number which, along with the MNE and TYP, is used to match the SRF Contact Message with the appropriate Supervised Release File record. Indicated at end of each SRF record. The source for the IDN varies with the record type. IDN Record Type CDC# CDC (CDC Parole) CYA# CYA (CYA Parole) OCA# PRO (County Probation) OCA# CAR (Career Criminal) OCA# FPR (Federal Probation) VCIN FCN# SRG (Sex Registrant) VCIN FCN# ARG (Arson VCIN Registrant) VCIN FCN# KTV (Violent Offender)
